units_and_clocks.clock: Each generator supplies whole five-second windows, starting at its own scheduled clock. The first complete end at/after ramp+5 and last strictly before cutoff define the occupancy set. CPU/traffic ratios use exact completions between the stated endpoints and interpolate native counters with scored brackets.
units_and_clocks.eligibility: Completed stock failures remain visible. All-shard dials/full occupancy, source/geometry/clock and component-lock validation, scored external evidence, packet drops and OOM are separate checks. A missing or flagged run cannot qualify.
units_and_clocks.flags: A nonzero retransmit count alone is neither a stock request timeout nor a link drop. TCP counters/peak/flags describe native samples strictly before cutoff; the first later memory sample is identified separately.
units_and_clocks.hash: raw_manifest_sha256 covers the UTF-8 sorted, compact JSON map of raw receipt filenames to file SHA-256 from cohort.py.
units_and_clocks.one_second: Whole-score histogram bounds count samples guaranteed strictly over and samples possibly over 1000 ms. At 1 s the midpoint of bucket 1388 counts against the stock percentile. Budget uses N - ceil(0.99*N).
units_and_clocks.stock: Unmodified merged scorer over scheduled ramp and hold. CPU, NAPI and TAP counters are separate native captures.
